entries.name_zh: 南非·德斯蒙德·图图：真相和解与彩虹国家道德权威
entries.name_en: South Africa Desmond Tutu: Truth Reconciliation & Rainbow Nation Moral Authority
entries.description_zh: 德斯蒙德·图图 (1931-2021) 南非圣公会大主教，诺贝尔和平奖得主，真相与和解委员会主席，以基督教宽恕伦理愈合种族创伤，推动彩虹国家建构，反对科尔宾反犹太主义。
entries.description_en: Desmond Tutu (1931-2021) South African Anglican Archbishop, Nobel Peace Prize laureate, Truth and Reconciliation Commission chair, Christian forgiveness ethics healed racial wounds, promoted Rainbow Nation construction, opposed Corbyn antisemitism.
entries.reason_zh: 图图代表宗教道德权威如何在政治转型中提供愈合机制，展示了真相委员会如何通过宽恕而非报复实现社会和解，其彩虹国家愿景成为后冲突社会伦理标杆。
entries.reason_en: Tutu represents how religious moral authority provides healing mechanism in political transition, demonstrating how truth commission achieves social reconciliation through forgiveness not retribution, his Rainbow Nation vision becoming post-conflict society ethical benchmark.
steps_zh: 研究图图早年教师与神学教育反种族隔离觉醒
分析1984年诺贝尔和平奖与国际反种隔声援
探讨1995年真相与和解委员会主席宽恕听证
评估彩虹国家愿景与后曼德拉时代腐败批判
总结真相和解诺贝尔神职彩虹道德对全球转型正义的范式贡献
steps_en: Study Tutu early teacher and theological education anti-apartheid awakening
Analyze 1984 Nobel Peace Prize and international anti-apartheid solidarity
Explore 1995 Truth Reconciliation Commission chair forgiveness hearings
Evaluate Rainbow Nation vision and post-Mandela era corruption critique
Summarize truth reconciliation Nobel clergy rainbow morality paradigm contribution for global transitional justice
entries.expected_zh: 掌握宗教宽恕伦理如何转化为政治和解制度设计，理解真相委员会听证机制如何平衡正义与愈合，评估图图模式对卢旺达塞拉利昂等真相委员会的直接启示。
entries.expected_en: Master how religious forgiveness ethics transforms into political reconciliation institutional design, grasp truth commission hearing mechanism balancing justice and healing, evaluate Tutu model direct lessons for Rwanda Sierra Leone truth commissions.
entries.case_zh: 1984 诺贝尔；1995 真相委员会；彩虹国家；2021 逝世。真相和解诺贝尔神职彩虹道德范式永存。
entries.case_en: 1984 Nobel; 1995 TRC; Rainbow Nation; 2021 death. Truth reconciliation Nobel clergy rainbow morality paradigm endures.
entries.cross_cultural_impact: Truth commission; forgiveness; Rainbow Nation; transitional justice

entries.name_zh: 津巴布韦·罗伯特·穆加贝：土地改革独裁与恶性通胀钻石遗产
entries.name_en: Zimbabwe Robert Mugabe: Land Reform Dictatorship & Hyperinflation Diamonds Legacy
entries.description_zh: 罗伯特·穆加贝 (1924-2019) 津巴布韦总统 (1980-2017)，早年解放英雄晚年独裁者，2000年快速土地改革驱逐白人农场主，恶性通胀摧毁经济，马拉维钻石争夺，2017年政变下台。
entries.description_en: Robert Mugabe (1924-2019) Zimbabwe President (1980-2017), early liberation hero late dictator, 2000 fast-track land reform expelled white farmers, hyperinflation destroyed economy, Marange diamonds争夺, 2017 coup ousted.
entries.reason_zh: 穆加贝代表解放英雄如何异化为独裁者，展示了土地改革如何从正义诉求演变为掠夺性掠夺，恶性通胀与钻石资源诅咒双重摧毁了非洲曾经的面包篮子。
entries.reason_en: Mugabe represents how liberation hero mutates into dictator, demonstrating how land reform evolved from justice demand into predatory plunder, hyperinflation and diamond resource curse dual destruction of Africas former breadbasket.
steps_zh: 研究穆加贝早年教师与游击战争领袖
分析1980年独立与兰开斯特宫协议土地条款
探讨2000年快速土地改革与白人农场主驱逐
评估2008年恶性通胀与马拉维钻石军方掠夺
总结土地改革独裁恶性通胀钻石遗产对津巴布韦发展的毁灭性打击
steps_en: Study Mugabe early teacher and guerrilla war leader
Analyze 1980 independence and Lancaster House land clauses
Explore 2000 fast-track land reform and white farmer expulsion
Evaluate 2008 hyperinflation and Marange diamonds military plunder
Summarize land reform dictatorship hyperinflation diamonds legacy devastating blow to Zimbabwe development
entries.expected_zh: 理解解放遗产如何被独权力异化掠夺工具，掌握土地改革从正义到掠夺的异化机制，评估穆加贝遗产对南部非洲民主化与资源治理的警示。
entries.expected_en: Understand how liberation legacy mutates into dictatorial plunder tool, grasp land reform evolution from justice to plunder mechanism, evaluate Mugabe legacy warning for Southern African democratization and resource governance.
entries.case_zh: 1980 独立；2000 土地改革；2008 恶性通胀；2017 政变。土地改革独裁恶性通胀钻石范式永存。
entries.case_en: 1980 independence; 2000 land reform; 2008 hyperinflation; 2017 coup. Land reform dictatorship hyperinflation diamonds paradigm endures.
entries.intellectual_tradition: Zimbabwean Nationalism / Land Reform / Resource Curse
entries.cross_cultural_impact: Liberation hero to dictator; land reform; hyperinflation; diamond curse
